Subject: Your land dispute matter

Dear Ms. Deshpande,

Thank you for meeting us on 16 August 2020 about your dispute with Lakshmi Shetty. As we understand it, relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land.

Our advice is to trace the chain of title through the mutation entries. Please collect the mutation entries, the partition deed and the old sale deeds and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 68,50,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
